description:
Stored market_price_moved detections with held flags, newest episode first, kept 90 days from when storing began (November 2026): every move of 2 cents or more in a sports or esports market's outcome-0 midpoint over 60, 120, 300 or 900 seconds, one item per market, window and episode (the episode's largest step). Each item is the market_price_moved payload plus move_id, episode_started_at and outcome_after: outcome 0's midpoint 15 and 60 minutes after detected_at and at a pre-game move's scheduled kickoff, read from the live order book, with held true when the midpoint there kept at least half of the move. A null held flag means not measured, never false. A page reads a fixed share of the history, so with narrow filters it can hold fewer than limit items, even none, while has_more is true: follow next_cursor until has_more is false.

Args:
  - league (string, optional): One league prefix, lowercase, such as nba, nfl, epl or cs2
  - event_slug (string, optional): One Polymarket event (game)
  - condition_id (string, optional): One market; raw condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id. Name at most one of league, event_slug and condition_id
  - min_move_cents (number, 1-99, default 1): Least whole-cent level the move reached (level_cents)
  - window_seconds (number, optional): 60, 120, 300 or 900
  - phase (string, optional): pre_game or in_play
  - held (string, optional): 15m, 60m or kickoff; only moves that held there
  - min_book_usd_within_2c (number, optional): Least whole USD resting within 2 cents of the midpoint on each side
  - since/until (string, optional): RFC3339 bounds on episode_started_at, since inclusive, until exclusive
  - limit (number, 1-200, default 50): Moves per page
  - cursor (string, optional): next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

Returns: data (each move's market_price_moved fields, move_id, episode_started_at and outcome_after with status pending or final and mid, read time, held flag and unavailable_reason per checkpoint), has_more, next_cursor and meta. A 503 read_model_warming means retry after Retry-After; a market or event outside sports and esports answers market_out_of_scope, and a condition_id or event_slug no stored market carries answers not_found.

condition_id.description: One market's moves; raw provider condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; send the same filters with it

event_slug.description: One Polymarket event (game): the moves of each of its markets

held.description: Only moves whose midpoint there kept at least half of the move; a move not measured there is left out

league.description: One league prefix, lowercase, as the event slug starts: nba, nfl, epl, cs2. Name at most one of league, event_slug and condition_id

min_book_usd_within_2c.description: Least whole USD resting within 2 cents of the midpoint on each side when the move was detected; a move with no measured depth is left out

min_move_cents.description: Least whole-cent level the move reached (level_cents); the detector stores moves of 2 cents or more

phase.description: Only moves detected in this game phase; omitted, every phase

since.description: Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on episode_started_at; nothing older than 90 days

until.description: Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on episode_started_at

window_seconds.description: Only moves measured over this window: 60, 120, 300 or 900 seconds

name: list_price_moves
title: List stored price moves
